phases.name: discovery
phases.brief: Find prior art, constraints and unanswered questions.

phases.name: design
phases.brief: Choose an approach and explain the trade-offs.

phases.name: plan
phases.brief: Specify the workload, success checks and escalation conditions.

phases.name: implementation
phases.brief: Build and exercise the proposed change.

phases.name: verification
phases.brief: Challenge the result against the acceptance conditions.

phases.name: release
phases.brief: Collect the independently authorized release outcome. Passage cannot authorize or execute it.
